and the Alarms tab, which had nothing in it

what I found

The Alarms tab called a function named showAlarmsList in two places — and that function was never written. Measured: typeof came back undefined. So the tab could never have shown anything. It is built now.

I was wrong about this one first, and here is the real cause

I told you the Location buttons were "dead buttons with no action". That was wrong — I called the code the wrong way when testing. Picking Routines did work: it set a repeat on the task.

The real problem: the Routines tab reads a different list. Making a routine set a repeat on the task, while the tab reads routines — two stores that never met. Picking Routines now writes to both.

5

Due date: Today and Tomorrow, and the calendar closes

waiting on you

BUILT — WAITING ON YOU

Where: the edit dialog → Due Date → the calendar.

"In the due date section, the button Today and Tomorrow actually do not work. It needs to move back the date to today and tomorrow where it is selected."

now (live)

Pressing Today changed the date in the field, but the calendar stayed on October and November and never closed — so it looked as if nothing had happened.

after

Pressing Today or Tomorrow sets the date and closes the calendar, so you see the result immediately.

the cause

The close looked for the calendar as a parent of the date field. It is not — it floats above it. So it was never found, never closed, and never redrawn.
